title: Complete debugger command editor in Wine
changes: Accept DBG2-14 within its selected scope: explicit command editing, history, completion, contextual help, clipboard, controller keyboard and isolated input handling.
validation: Earlier Wine GUI/model evidence covers typing, correction, recall, cancellation, focus isolation, simulated controller and multiline clipboard. Current Wine GUI covers real IBus Cangjie composition, cancellation, repeated results, F2, focus/hide and Italian layout; missing capability produces incompatible/not-sent without changing request, result or guest state.
limitations: Wine/Xvfb and simulated inputs exercise selected paths only; physical hardware, native Windows/Linux, other IMEs and complete Unicode font coverage remain DBG2-27 integration work.
